name: Animal Crossing-e: PR - Design Card: NES Link
summary: PR NES Link is a promotional Animal Crossing-e Design Card. This card was only released in North America, where it was included with Volume 163 (December 2002) of Nintendo Power. It can be scanned in Animal Crossing to save the card's design, or on the Game Boy Advance by itself to display the design and a message from Sable.
